title: Chroma Joins Replit to Build Memory Layer for AI Agents
summary:
The team from vector database developer Chroma is joining Replit to develop a "context layer" designed to give AI agents memory. Replit CEO Amjad Masad said the move will help solve technical challenges in providing agents with the context they need to perform substantive work.

Chroma developed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tools before the technology became widely adopted. Replit stated that the integration of the Chroma team is a step toward its goal of building a "self-driving company."
